actual: RD-Agent qe_evolution_api initializes log offsets at zero for every SSE connection and scans run.log files each second. Reconnects replay complete history and AIstock mirrors duplicate multi-gigabyte content. Implement stable opaque cursor with stream identity and sequence, SSE id plus Last-Event-ID/after_cursor, bounded initial tail, explicit 410 qe_log_cursor_expired for malformed or stale cursors, and heartbeat comments that are never persisted. Must not control qrun/backend processes or delete logs.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
